mechanicNote: Weapon effects (Shrapnel, Power Surge, Frost Vortex, Bounce, Fast Gunner, Burn, Unstable Bomber, Fortress Warfare, Marked) are granted by the mod you equip as a weapon's core-effect slot, and most can go on almost any weapon in that mod's compatible slot — they are not locked to one gun. A small number of named legendary weapons additionally have their own confirmed built-in special ability (see each weapon's own page). The 'primary weapon' below is the community-recommended pick that best exploits a given build's playstyle (fire rate, magazine size, trigger rate, etc.) — not the only weapon that can run it.

builds.name: Shrapnel Crit Build
builds.summary: Once Human's premier build for destroying the Great Ones and general PvE. Bullets fragment to tear through multiple body parts; can be specced for crit, weakspot hits, or a no-reload playstyle. Aim for a Shrapnel proc chance near 50% (about 1 in every 2 shots).
recommendedArmor: 4pc Lonewolf Set + 1pc Bastille + Beret headpiece (Beret increases how many parts Shrapnel can hit) — a common endgame pick, ~15,000 Starchrom.
Alternative: 4pc Falcon Set for Crit DMG + 2pc Lonewolf for Crit Rate.

builds.name: Power Surge Build
builds.summary: Dump full magazines into enemies to trigger bursts of Electric/Shock damage that stack on top of regular weapon damage with no real downside. Community reports of a well-optimized version topping out around 100,000 DPS circulate widely.
builds.dpsClaimNote: This ~100,000 DPS figure is a community-reported estimate, not a value this database independently measured. Exact weapon/mod combination, calibration level, food/buffs, target (training dummy vs. live boss), and game patch used to produce it are unknown — treat it as directional, not a guarantee.
recommendedArmor: Mayfly Goggles (head) — reduces Power Surge's own damage 30% but doubles how many Shock DMG instances proc; the drawback becomes negligible once you stack enough damage buffs.
Endgame: 4pc Shelterer Set for extra Elemental DMG. Without the MPS7 – Outer Space, an alternative is Gas Mask Hood + Lonewolf Set for a SOCR Outsider variant.
builds.foodNote: No build-specific food recommendation was found in the guides searched for this build — general Energy Drink consumables (recharge rate) were mentioned but not a specific recipe. See Food & Cooking for general Elemental/Shock-relevant options.

builds.name: Frost Vortex Build
builds.summary: Excellent against big boss enemies — the vortex feeds you health while draining theirs, making it a strong solo/duo boss-clearing build.
recommendedArmor: Stealth Walker chest piece + 4pc Shelterer Set + one spare slot (e.g. Heavy Duty for its +10% Max HP 1-piece bonus).
builds.foodNote: Honey-Glazed Meat adds Crit DMG against enemies affected by Frost Vortex; Mixed Fried Hotdog supports a Bull's Eye secondary; Whimsical Drink gives +30% PSI Intensity (boosts status-effect potency, including Frost).
builds.recommendedDeviant: Polar Jelly (Combat Deviant) — frequently cited as important for sustaining this build.

builds.name: Bounce Build
builds.summary: An underrated build where projectiles ricochet between enemies; damage gets absurd in tight corridors or dense groups of mobs.
recommendedArmor: Agent Set (Helmet/Face/Gloves/Shoes) for +10% Weakspot DMG plus its stacking Bullet Saver perk (up to +45% Weakspot DMG from precise kills).
Alternative mix: Agent + Bastille — Bastille Jacket (torso) for +10% Weapon DMG above 70% HP, Hot Dog Shorts (legs) for +2 Bounces.
builds.foodNote: Both recipes boost weakspot damage; guides cite eating both together for a combined weakspot-damage increase of roughly 80%.

builds.name: Fast Gunner LMG Build
builds.summary: Buffs a gun's damage and fire rate the longer you shoot. Best on high-magazine LMGs — a properly built MG4 Predator is reported to unload roughly 200 rounds before needing to reload (community-reported figure, not independently re-measured for this database).
recommendedArmor: 4pc Lonewolf + 1pc Bastille + Oasis Mask (Wish Machine, ~8,000 Starchrom; +10 max Fast Gunner stacks, +1% damage per stack).
Alternative: 3pc Bastille for a flat +10% Fire Rate.
builds.foodNote: Assorted Canned Fruit gives +25% Weakspot DMG above 80% Sanity; Shattered Bread gives +10% Weapon DMG; Stargazy Pie gives +25% Crit DMG; Corn Ale locks Sanity above 80% for 30 minutes to keep the Canned Fruit bonus active; Shellfish Meat adds +5% vulnerability damage for the party.
